unquote scripts/stdout.txt
unquote scripts/stderr.txt
unquote scripts/file.txt
unquote scripts/negated.txt
unquote scripts/cmpenv.txt
unquote stdout-new.txt
unquote stderr-new.txt
unquote file-new.txt
cp scripts/negated.txt negated-unchanged.txt
cp scripts/cmpenv.txt cmpenv-unchanged.txt

testscript -update scripts
cmp scripts/stdout.txt stdout-new.txt
cmp scripts/stderr.txt stderr-new.txt
cmp scripts/file.txt file-new.txt
cmp scripts/negated.txt negated-unchanged.txt
cmp scripts/cmpenv.txt cmpenv-unchanged.txt

-- scripts/stdout.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>cmp want stdout
>
>-- want --
>wrong
>-- stdout --
>not captured output
-- scripts/stderr.txt --
>fprintargs stderr right
>cmp want stderr
>
>-- want --
>wrong
-- scripts/file.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>cp stdout got
>cmp want got
>
>-- want --
>wrong
-- stdout-new.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>cmp want stdout
>
>-- want --
>right
>-- stdout --
>not captured output
-- scripts/negated.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>! cmp want stdout
>
>-- want --
>wrong
-- scripts/cmpenv.txt --
>env VALUE=right
>fprintargs stdout '$VALUE'
>cmpenv want stdout
>
>-- want --
>right
-- stderr-new.txt --
>fprintargs stderr right
>cmp want stderr
>
>-- want --
>right
-- file-new.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>cp stdout got
>cmp want got
>
>-- want --
>right
